data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 16.2m (2015: GBP 21.9m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years. The 2014 underwriting year result improved by GBP 32.3m as a result of favourable claims development on prior years, including several cases where we have seen claims settling for less than their loss reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 510 opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 1,070.5m. During 2016 prior-year reserve development produced a small net gross strengthening of approximately GBP 1.8m (c.0.17% of opening reserves). The gross movement reflects adverse development on the 2014 underwriting year that was partially offset by favourable run-off on older years. The managing agent attributes prior year movements primarily to case-level and run-off experience (described as favourable claims development in parts of the report), while the 2016 calendar year also experienced notable catastrophe activity (eg Hurricane Matthew, Canadian wildfires) which affected current year claims rather than being the primary driver of prior-year reserve changes.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding GBP 1,070,529k at 31/12/2015). No explicit single-line gross 'movement in prior years' note was present; gross prior-year movement was derived from the gross claims development triangle (sold as 'Gross of reinsurance' triangle) by comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <=2014, producing a small net gross strengthening of ~GBP 1.8m. The report contains net prior-year figures quoted in text (eg surplus of GBP 16.2m) - these are net of reinsurance and were not used for the gross PYD figure. Some divisional prior-year improvements are reported for the closed 2014 year of account (used in lob_movements). Historical RITC activity (eg Syndicate 807 run-off into 2012) appears in the report and may distort long-tail development patterns; triangle-based PYD was used with caution.
